lines: Moves the character toward the aimed target before a charged fist attack, stopping at striking distance. With no target it travels forward a shorter distance; area of effect does not change its range.

lines: A protective layer in front of health: it takes only the damage left after every reduction (resistances, block, armour and the rest). Spirit and poison damage bypass it. After a pause without damage, the shield recharges; recharge delay and regeneration control this recovery. A hit you evade interrupts the recharge the same way taking damage does.
